dsp GenChipNoiseShortSwellSlideDown where

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + slA * 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let heldA := select(lt(ph, 0.07), noise1(fract(seed + ph * 13.0) * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0, held)
    set held := heldA
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.61803)
    let w := heldA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.3744

dsp GenChipNoiseLongBlipPlain where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.15 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let heldA := select(lt(ph, 0.5), noise1(fract(seed + ph * 13.0) * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0, held)
    set held := heldA
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.61803)
    let w := heldA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.4384

dsp GenChipNoiseLongBlipSlideUp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.15 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envA := select(trigger, gate, env * expneg(5.0 / (life * 1.0 * sr)))
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 - slA * 0.5 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let heldA := select(lt(ph, 0.5), noise1(fract(seed + ph * 13.0) * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0, held)
    set held := heldA
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.61803)
    let w := heldA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.5084

dsp GenChipNoiseLongNoteVibrato where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 0.8 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.002 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.012
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let heldA := select(lt(ph, 0.5), noise1(fract(seed + ph * 13.0) * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0, held)
    set held := heldA
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.61803)
    let w := heldA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.4279

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)

    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)

    set held := heldA
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.61803)

dsp GenChipNoiseLongSwellSlideUp where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state sl : F32 := 0.0
  state held : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.25 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    let slA := select(trigger, 1.0, sl * expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)))
    set sl := slA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.0 / sr)
    let bend := 1.0 - slA * 0.5 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * bend / sr))
    let heldA := select(lt(ph, 0.5), noise1(fract(seed + ph * 13.0) * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0, held)
    set held := heldA
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.61803)
    let w := heldA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((w * envA * 0.5) * 1.0) * 0.4346

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state b0 : F32 := 0.0
  state b1 : F32 := 0.0

dsp GenBeat0p33ReedUnison where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state b0 : F32 := 0.0
  state b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state o : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set b0 := fract(b0 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + (0.0 - 0.3)) / sr))
    set b1 := fract(b1 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 0.0) / sr))
    set b2 := fract(b2 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 0.3) / sr))
    set o := fract(o + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((fold(sinpi(b0 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 2.0)) + fold(sinpi(b1 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 2.0)) + fold(sinpi(b2 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 2.0))) * 0.333333 * envA) * 0.9) * 0.7605

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0

dsp GenBeat12ReedOctave where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state b0 : F32 := 0.0
  state b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state o : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set b0 := fract(b0 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + (0.0 - 0.5)) / sr))
    set b1 := fract(b1 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 0.5) / sr))
    set o := fract(o + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((fold(sinpi(b0 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 2.0)) + fold(sinpi(b1 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 2.0)) + sinpi(o * 2.0) * 0.4) * 0.5 * envA) * 0.9) * 0.7455

dsp GenBeat13ReedUnison where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state b0 : F32 := 0.0
  state b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state o : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set b0 := fract(b0 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + (0.0 - 1.0)) / sr))
    set b1 := fract(b1 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 0.0) / sr))
    set b2 := fract(b2 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 1.0) / sr))
    set o := fract(o + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((fold(sinpi(b0 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 2.0)) + fold(sinpi(b1 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 2.0)) + fold(sinpi(b2 * 2.0) * (1.0 + colour * 2.0))) * 0.333333 * envA) * 0.9) * 0.7609

dsp GenBeat2p52SineOctave where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state b0 : F32 := 0.0
  state b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state o : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.8 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

    set env := envA
    set b0 := fract(b0 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + (0.0 - 1.25)) / sr))
    set b1 := fract(b1 + min(0.45, (max(24.0, freq) + 1.25) / sr))
    set o := fract(o + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * 2.0 / sr))
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(((sinpi(b0 * 2.0) + sinpi(b1 * 2.0) + sinpi(o * 2.0) * 0.4) * 0.5 * envA) * 0.9) * 0.5666
